title: 129th Rescue Wing Rescues Fisherman over Veteran's Day Weekend
description: U.S. Air Force HH-60G Pave Hawk rescue helicopter assigned with the 129th Rescue Squadron, 129th Rescue Wing, California Air National Guard hover over a fishing vessel to medically evacuate an ill fisherman during a rescue operation, approximately 400 miles off the coast of San Diego, Nov. 8, 2024.  The patient is on a chartered fishing trip when he began experiencing stroke like symptoms. (U.S. Air Force courtesy video)
